summary: Iteration 51 (Ambience Bed + Southern Hemisphere + Weekly NEW Pill) — 22/22 backend pytest passed; all 5 frontend flows verified end-to-end. SH content correctly authored with region-appropriate seasonality (january-sh=High Summer, july-sh=Deep Winter incl. 'Winter Light Through Gum Leaves' with gum-tree imagery, september-sh=Early Spring FREE). Ambience bed measurably present in mixed MP3 vs. voice-only (march-nh spring bed and january-sh summer bed both audible in silent gaps). Header 'NEW' pill appears, and clears correctly after native audio.play() → onPlay → localStorage['patchpot.calm.played.v1']={'july-nh':true} → reload → pill gone.

minor.issue: HEAD requests still return 405 (carry-over from iteration 50, non-blocking — GET works with correct audio/mpeg). Route decorator now lists @router.head as well but FastAPI's FileResponse path still 405s on HEAD in practice. UX unaffected — browsers use GET.

issues: Pre-existing shadcn warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' repeated 4x per hamburger open. Non-blocking accessibility hygiene — carry-over, not introduced this iteration.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add explicit HEAD handler on /api/calm/{slug}/audio.mp3 (Starlette's FileResponse still 405s on HEAD despite @router.head decorator — verify with `curl -I` after fix). Not blocking any UX flow.
OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to SheetContent to silence shadcn a11y warnings on hamburger open.
critical_code_review_comments: calm.py _mix_voice_with_ambience overlays bed BENEATH voice via `bed.overlay(voice)` — verified by measuring RMS in silent gaps (~-35 to -45 dBFS in mixed vs. -inf in voice-only). Design is sound.

useCalmPill.js: `setAvailable(!!r.data.audio_generated || !r.data.not_yet_authored)` — the `||` means the pill will surface even if audio isn't generated as long as `not_yet_authored` is falsy. This is intentional (locked-preview tease) but could show a NEW badge for a locked month with no audio yet; verify this is the desired UX. Currently harmless because all 24 SH+NH audios are already rendered.

Calm.jsx onPlay only fires markPlayed(active.slug). If a user plays a NON-current-month track (e.g. plays march-nh in July), the pill stays lit because the current-month slug isn't in the played map. Consider auto-marking the current-month slug whenever any variant is played, or make the pill copy less prescriptive. Not a bug per spec — spec explicitly says 'current-month audio hasn't been played'.
calm.py docstring still says 'default voice: Rachel' (carry-over from iter50) but code uses Lily. Cosmetic.

Region hook keys under `patchpot.patch.<active_id>.region.v1` — the review's suggestion 'localStorage.patchpot.region.v1' is stale (legacy key, migrated away in usePatches.js). For SH simulation the correct write is to the active patch's region key. Documented in test_calm_iter51 for next agent.
